queries.title: Search Queries
queries.description: Terms to search BetaList for. Each returns ~21 startups per page.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max Pages Per Query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: How many result pages to walk per query

maxStartups.title: Max Startups
maxStartups.description: Maximum startups to extract in total

fetchWebsite.title: Resolve Real Website
fetchWebsite.description: Follow each startup's /visit redirect to capture the real website domain. Costs one cheap extra request per startup.

useProxy.title: Use Proxy
useProxy.description: BetaList is not bot-protected, so this defaults to off to save cost.
